public_rationale: On the ordinary reading that meaningful progress had stalled, the claim is contradicted. OpenAI reported reductions in hallucinations and factual errors for the August release, and independent analysis found substantial reasoning-related benchmark gains. These improvements do not show that the problems were solved. If hit a wall instead means that complete solutions remain unavailable, or if every training refinement counts as a new technique, the verdict would not follow; those ambiguities are material.
limitations: Independent benchmark gains do not establish improvement on every real-world task.
The result depends on reading hit a wall as stalled progress rather than incomplete resolution.
The boundary between a refinement and a new technique is unspecified.
